=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:503-538 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The runner-wait credit measures elapsed time from `.run_started_at`, which reportedly excludes queue time, so reports that waited hours for a runner are still rejected as `identity_stale`.
  WHY: The credit therefore misses the 1h54m-3h25m runner wait it targets. Severity is MAJOR from three reviewers. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this finding after checking, saying `run_started_at` covers the runner wait.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:398-405 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `head_unpushed` only covers the gate path. In security-exhaustion mode `status` returns `unverifiable`, which `rb_security_merge_gate` (scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh:297-314) maps to `security_mode_unverified`, so the Telegram alert is not silenced.
  WHY: An exhausted PR with an unpushed `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit still gets the false CRITICAL "will not clear on its own" page. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR; the other reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:196-231 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The narrowed awk regex `/^ ?-[ \t]+/` no longer counts a real declined finding written as a nested bullet. The same count feeds the clean marker at lines 304-305.
  WHY: Such a finding gets neither the sandbox-excluded marker nor the identical-failure cap, and the clean same-head marker may fire. No test covers this case. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash considered the top-level-only counting intended.
- tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:669-670 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The only coverage of the `head_unpushed` alert suppression is a YAML substring check. `head_unpushed` was not added to the behavioural parametrized test `test_self_resolving_security_hold_sends_no_alert` (tests/test_review_rb_judge_security_pass.py:665).
  WHY: The substring check passes even if the case arm is reordered or unreachable. Adding `"head_unpushed"` to the parametrize list is a one-token change.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5930-5933 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The regex `attempt_elapsed_seconds=71\d\d ... max_age=10\d\d\d` accepts only a narrow elapsed window (7190-7199).
  WHY: A slow runner or container pushes the value to 72xx, so the test flakes although the behaviour is correct.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:398-405 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `head_unpushed` only helps the non-exhausted gate path. In security-exhaustion mode `status` prints `unverifiable`, which line 313 of scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh maps to `security_mode_unverified`.
  WHY: An exhausted PR with an unpushed `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit still gets the false CRITICAL page.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:231 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The count now ignores any indented bullet, so a real declined finding written as a nested bullet is not counted. The count is read again around lines 304-305.
  WHY: Such a finding gets neither the marker nor the cap, and could receive the clean same-head marker. The tests cover only the sub-bullet explanation shapes.
- tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:669-670 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The only coverage of the alert suppression is a substring check on the workflow text. `head_unpushed` was not added to the behavioural test at tests/test_review_rb_judge_security_pass.py:665.
  WHY: The substring test passes if the `case` arm is moved or unreachable.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5933 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test sets the attempt start to now-7190 and accepts only elapsed values 7190-7199.
  WHY: A slow setup can push the value to 72xx and fail the test although the behaviour is correct.
- (Rejected by this reviewer: the openai_gpt-6-luna claim that the runner-wait credit misses queue time at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:521-532. Not reported.)
- HARDENING: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py lines 441-449 and 676-684: the filter `"/attempts/" not in arg` would admit future job-list or log reads under `/attempts/`. Suggested fix: match `re.search(r"/actions/runs/\d+/attempts/\d+$", arg)`. About 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:521-532 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The runner-wait credit uses `run_started_at`, which excludes queue time.
  WHY: Reports that wait hours in the queue are still rejected as `identity_stale`, because queue time is not counted against the 3600-second threshold.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:398-405 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `head_unpushed` is applied only in the gate path. In security-exhaustion mode the judge calls `status`, which returns `unverifiable` for unpushed commits.
  WHY: `security_mode_unverified` is not handled in the Telegram alert logic in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, so the false CRITICAL page still fires.
- tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:669-670 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new self-clearing alert behaviour is tested only by a YAML substring check.
  WHY: The test passes even if the logic in review_autofix.yml is unreachable or reordered.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5933 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex `attempt_elapsed_seconds=71\d\d` in `test_intake_credits_runner_wait_against_report_identity_age` is too narrow.
  WHY: On slower CI the elapsed time can reach 7200+ and the test flakes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:503-538 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The credit is computed from `.run_started_at`, so it never captures the runner wait between `created_at` and `run_started_at`. The comment at lines 507-510 states a false intent. scripts/consumer_health_check.py:102-105 and scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:505-507 treat `created_at` as the queued-time field.
  WHY: For runs 43439048054, 43496779526 and 43498856864, `now - run_started_at` is only seconds, so REPORT_MAX_AGE stays about 3600 s and the token is still rejected as `identity_stale`. The test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5926-5936 mis-models the bug, and the README (lines 2498-2513, 2827) repeats the claim.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:196-231 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The narrowed regex `/^ ?-[ \t]+/` silently stops counting nested real declined findings toward `sandbox_excluded_findings`, which also feeds the clean marker at lines 304-305.
  WHY: Editor output with indented bullets loses its decline accounting. The test at lines 217-248 does not cover a nested-but-real declined finding.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:398-405 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `head_unpushed` is only meaningful in `gate` mode. In `status` mode (used at scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh:304) the state is `unverifiable`, which maps to `security_mode_unverified`. The Telegram silence list at .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5512 does not match that reason.
  WHY: An exhausted PR with an unpushed `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit still pages CRITICAL with the wrong reason.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5933 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The assertion restricts elapsed to 7190-7199 and `max_age` to 10000-10099.
  WHY: A busy runner can produce 72xx and fail the test spuriously.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py:441-449 and 676-684 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The filter `"/actions/" in arg and "/attempts/" not in arg` admits any URL containing `/attempts/`, not only the intake's run-attempt read.
  WHY: A future per-source-run read for the synced-security flow would not be caught by this contract assertion.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:521-525 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The runner-wait credit measures elapsed time from the attempt's `run_started_at`, which does not include time spent queued.
  WHY: A report can wait over an hour for a runner and still be rejected as `identity_stale`, so the 1h54m-3h25m failures are not resolved.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5930-5933 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The assertion accepts only `attempt_elapsed_seconds` values from 7100 through 7199.
  WHY: A delay of ten seconds or more after `now` is captured pushes the value to 7200 and fails the test although the behaviour is correct.
- HARDENING: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py:446: the assertion excludes every API argument containing `/attempts/`. Suggested fix: exempt only the exact own-run attempt endpoint shape. 1-3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh:304-314 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Fix 3 covers only the gate path. In security-exhaustion mode `status` reports `unverifiable`, which `rb_security_merge_gate` maps to `RB_SECURITY_HOLD_REASON=security_mode_unverified`. The Telegram case silences only the audit_dispatched, audit_pending, awaiting_followups and head_unpushed reasons (see scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:398-405 and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5512).
  WHY: An exhausted PR whose conflict-resolver commit is unpushed at judge time still gets the false CRITICAL page.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_security_pass.py:665 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The only coverage for the `head_unpushed` silence is a YAML substring assertion (tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:669-670). The parametrized behavioural test still lists only audit_dispatched, audit_pending and awaiting_followups.
  WHY: A regression that drops or misorders the arm reintroduces the CRITICAL page while all tests stay green.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5933 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The regex accepts only a 10-second window (elapsed 7190-7199).
  WHY: Container or harness slop beyond 10 seconds makes a correct run fail, a flaky failure on a loaded gate.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py:444-445 and 679-680 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The relaxed filter `("/actions/" in arg and "/attempts/" not in arg)` admits any URL containing `/attempts/`.
  WHY: A future read of attempt job listings or logs would pass the "no log, run or diagnosis read" assertion silently.
- (Rejected by this reviewer: the openai_gpt-6-luna MAJOR on scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:521-532, and the claim that nested declined findings need counting.)
